الفصل 4: CSS 1 — المحددات والتنسيق الأساسي

من يأخذ أي مظهر، ومن يفوز عند التعارض، وكيف يُحسب حجم كل صندوق: أساس كل تصميم ويب.

01 نظرة عامة

ما موضوع المحاضرة؟

الفصل 4 من Connolly & Hoar: CSS 1: المحددات والتنسيق الأساسي. ما هو CSS ومزاياه وإصداراته، صياغة القواعد (محدد، خاصية، قيمة)، الألوان والوحدات، أماكن الأنماط الثلاثة، المحددات (عنصر، class، id، خصائص، زائفة، سياقية)، التتالي (الوراثة، التحديد، الموقع)، نموذج الصندوق (عناصر كتلية ومضمنة، خلفيات، حدود، هوامش وحشو، border-box، overflow، النسب)، تنسيق النص (العائلات، الأحجام وrem، @font-face، الأوزان، خصائص الفقرة)، وأخيرًا أطر CSS ومتغيراتها.

Chapter 4 of Connolly & Hoar: CSS 1: Selectors and Basic Styling. What CSS is, its benefits and versions, rule syntax (selector, property, value), colours and units, the three style locations, selectors (element, class, id, attribute, pseudo, contextual), the cascade (inheritance, specificity, location), the box model (block vs inline, backgrounds, borders, margins and padding, border-box, overflow, percentages), text styling (families, sizes and rem, @font-face, weights, paragraph properties), and CSS frameworks and variables.

الفكرة الأساسية

CSS يقرر أي عناصر (المحدد) تأخذ أي مظهر (الخصائص)، وعند التعارض يحسم التتالي: الوراثة ثم التحديد (id > class > element) ثم الموقع (الأخير يفوز). وكل عنصر صندوق: محتوى + حشو + حد + هامش.

CSS decides which elements (selector) get which look (properties); on conflict the cascade decides: inheritance, then specificity (id > class > element), then location (last wins). And every element is a box: content + padding + border + margin.

قائمة المفاهيم الأساسية

  • صياغة القاعدة (8–13)
  • الألوان والوحدات (14–15)
  • inline/embedded/external (17–20)
  • المحددات الأساسية (21–25)
  • محددات الخصائص (26–28)
  • الزائفة (29–32)
  • السياقية (33–35)
  • التتالي (36–40)
  • نموذج الصندوق (41–55)
  • تنسيق النص (56–63)
  • الأطر والمتغيرات (64–69)
  • Rule syntax (8–13)
  • Colours and units (14–15)
  • Inline/embedded/external (17–20)
  • Basic selectors (21–25)
  • Attribute selectors (26–28)
  • Pseudo selectors (29–32)
  • Contextual selectors (33–35)
  • The cascade (36–40)
  • The box model (41–55)
  • Text styling (56–63)
  • Frameworks and variables (64–69)

المهارات المكتسبة

  • كتابة قواعد CSS صحيحة.
  • اختيار المحدد المناسب.
  • حساب التحديد وحل التعارضات.
  • حساب أبعاد الصندوق في content-box وborder-box.
  • بناء مكدس خطوط مناسب.
  • Write correct CSS rules.
  • Choose the right selector.
  • Compute specificity and resolve conflicts.
  • Compute box sizes under content-box and border-box.
  • Build a sensible font stack.

لماذا يهم؟

كل صفحة حديثة تعتمد على CSS للشكل والتجاوب؛ وفهم التتالي ونموذج الصندوق يوفر ساعات من «لماذا لا يتغير اللون؟» و«لماذا العنصر أعرض من المتوقع؟».

Every modern page relies on CSS for looks and responsiveness; understanding the cascade and box model saves hours of “why won't the colour change?” and “why is this wider than expected?”.

الشريحة 03 — What Is CSS?

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • CSS is a W3C standard for describing the appearance of HTML elements.
  • With CSS, we can assign font properties, colors, sizes, borders, background images, positioning and even animate elements on the page.
  • CSS can be added directly to any HTML element (via the style attribute), within the <head> element, or, most commonly, in a separate text file that contains only CSS.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. CSS is a W3C standard for describing the appearance of HTML elements.

    CSS معيار من W3C لوصف مظهر عناصر HTML.

    CSS is a W3C standard for describing how HTML elements look.

  2. With CSS, we can assign font properties, colors, sizes, borders, background images, positioning and even animate elements on the page.

    خطوط، ألوان، أحجام، حدود، خلفيات، مواضع، وحتى حركة.

    Fonts, colours, sizes, borders, backgrounds, positioning, even animation.

  3. CSS can be added directly to any HTML element (via the style attribute), within the <head> element, or, most commonly, in a separate text file that contains only CSS.

    ثلاثة أماكن: خاصية style، داخل <head>، أو (الأشهر) ملف منفصل.

    Three places: the style attribute, inside <head>, or (most often) a separate file.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

هذا يكمل الفصل 3: HTML للمعنى وCSS للمظهر.

This completes Chapter 3: HTML for meaning, CSS for appearance.

الخلاصة

CSS = المظهر.
CSS = appearance.

الشريحة 04 — Benefits of CSS

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Improved control over formatting.
  • Improved site maintainability. All formatting can be centralized into one CSS file
  • Improved accessibility. By keeping presentation out of the HTML, screen readers and other accessibility tools work better.
  • Improved page-download speed. Each individual HTML file will contain less style information and markup, and thus be smaller.
  • Improved output flexibility. CSS can be used to adopt a page for different output media. This approach to CSS page design is often referred to as responsive design.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشريحة 06 — CSS Versions

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Style sheets as a way to visually format markup predate the web.
  • W3C decided to adopt CSS, and by the end of 1996, the CSS Level 1 Recommendation was published
  • A year later, the CSS2 was published
  • CSS2.1, did not become an official W3C Recommendation until June 2011
  • At the same time the CSS2.1 standard was being worked on, a different group at the W3C was working on a CSS3 draft

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Style sheets as a way to visually format markup predate the web.

    أوراق الأنماط أقدم من الويب.

    Style sheets predate the web.

  2. …by the end of 1996, the CSS Level 1 Recommendation was published

    نهاية 1996: CSS1.

    End of 1996: CSS1.

  3. A year later, the CSS2 was published

    بعد سنة: CSS2.

    A year later: CSS2.

  4. CSS2.1, did not become an official W3C Recommendation until June 2011

    CSS2.1 لم يصبح توصية رسمية حتى يونيو 2011.

    CSS2.1 only became official in June 2011.

  5. …a different group at the W3C was working on a CSS3 draft

    بالتوازي: مسودة CSS3.

    In parallel: a CSS3 draft.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الخط الزمني: CSS1 (1996) ← CSS2 (1997) ← CSS2.1 (2011) والعمل على CSS3 بالتوازي (CSS3 مقسم إلى «وحدات» modules).

Timeline: CSS1 (1996) → CSS2 (1997) → CSS2.1 (2011), with CSS3 developed in parallel (split into modules).

الخلاصة

الشريحة 07 — Browser Adoption

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Perhaps the most important thing to keep in mind with CSS is that the different browsers have not always kept up with the W3C.
  • For this reason, CSS has a reputation for being a somewhat frustrating language.
  • In this book, we hope to redress that negative reputation by covering CSS basics and then incrementally introducing ideas until finally we cover modern frameworks that address many of those challenges.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  2. For this reason, CSS has a reputation for being a somewhat frustrating language.

    لذا سمعة CSS أنها «محبطة».

  3. …covering CSS basics and then incrementally introducing ideas until finally we cover modern frameworks…

    الكتاب يتدرج من الأساسيات إلى الأطر الحديثة.

    The book goes from basics to modern frameworks.

الشريحة 08 — CSS Syntax

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • A CSS document consists of one or more style rules.
  • A rule consists of a selector that identifies the HTML element or elements that will be affected, followed by a series of property:value pairs called the declaration
  • The series of declarations is also called the declaration block.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

selector { property: value; property2: value2; }

Labels: declaration · declaration block · rule · syntax

em { color: red; }

p {
   margin: 5px 0 10px 0;
   font-weight: bold;
   font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
}

Labels: selector · property · value · examples

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. A CSS document consists of one or more style rules.

    ملف CSS = قواعد.

    A CSS file = rules.

  2. A rule consists of a selector … followed by a series of property:value pairs called the declaration

    القاعدة = محدد + تصريحات property:value.

    A rule = selector + property:value declarations.

  3. The series of declarations is also called the declaration block.

    مجموعة التصريحات = كتلة التصريح.

    The set of declarations = the declaration block.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

Each declaration ends with ; and the block sits in { }.

الشريحة 13 — CSS Syntax: Values

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Each individual CSS declaration must also contain a value
  • The unit of any given value is dependent upon the property.
  • Some property values are from a predefined list of keywords. Others are values such as length measurements, percentages, numbers without units, color values, and URLs.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

    الوحدة تعتمد على الخاصية.

  3. Some property values are from a predefined list of keywords. Others are values such as length measurements, percentages, numbers without units, color values, and URLs.

    قيم: كلمات محددة، أطوال، نسب، أرقام، ألوان، روابط.

    Values: keywords, lengths, percentages, numbers, colours, URLs.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

مثال: font-weight تأخذ كلمة (bold)، margin تأخذ طولًا (5px)، background تأخذ رابطًا url(...).

E.g. font-weight takes a keyword (bold), margin a length (5px), background a url(...).

الخلاصة

القيمة ونوعها حسب الخاصية.
The value and its type depend on the property.

الشريحة 14 — TABLE 4.2 Color Values

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

TABLE 4.2 Color Values
MethodDescriptionExample
NameUse one of 17 standard color names. CSS3 has 140 standard names.color: red; color: hotpink; /* CSS3 only */
RGBUses three different numbers between 0 and 255 to describe the red, green, and blue values of the color.color: rgb(255,0,0); color: rgb(255,105,180);
HexadecimalUses a six-digit hexadecimal number to describe the red, green, and blue value of the colorcolor: #FF0000; color: #FF69B4;
RGBaThis defines a partially transparent background color. The “a” stands for “alpha,” which is a term used to identify a transparencycolor: rgba(255,0,0,0.5);
HSLAllows you to specify a color using Hue Saturation and Light values. This is available only in CSS3. HSLA is also available as well.color: hsl(0,100%,100%); color: hsla(330,59%,100%,0.5);

الشرح — شرح موسّع

نفس اللون الأحمر: red = rgb(255,0,0) = #FF0000. وفي hex كل خانتين = قناة: FF أحمر، 00 أخضر، 00 أزرق. والقناة a في rgba للشفافية (0 شفاف، 1 معتم).

The same red: red = rgb(255,0,0) = #FF0000. In hex each pair is a channel: FF red, 00 green, 00 blue. The a in rgba is opacity (0 transparent, 1 opaque).

مثال رقمي محلول

#FF69B4: FF = 255 أحمر، 69 = 105 أخضر، B4 = 180 أزرق ← rgb(255,105,180) = hotpink، وهذا ما يقوله الجدول.

الشريحة 15 — Common Units of Measure Values

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Units of measure in CSS are either
  • relative units, in that they are based on the value of something else, or
  • absolute units, in that they have a real-world size.
  • Some example measures (See Table 4.3 for more)
  • px Pixel. In CSS2 this is a relative measure, while in CSS3 it is absolute (1/96 of an inch)
  • em Equal to the computed value of the font-size property of the element on which it is used.
  • % A measure that is always relative to another value.
  • in Inches
  • cm Centimeters

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Units of measure in CSS are either relative units … or absolute units…

    الوحدات نسبية أو مطلقة.

    Units are relative or absolute.

  2. px Pixel. In CSS2 this is a relative measure, while in CSS3 it is absolute (1/96 of an inch)

    px: في CSS3 مطلقة = 1/96 بوصة.

    px: absolute in CSS3 = 1/96 inch.

  3. em Equal to the computed value of the font-size property of the element on which it is used.

    em = حجم خط العنصر.

    em = the element's font size.

  4. % A measure that is always relative to another value.

    % نسبة من قيمة أخرى.

    % is relative to another value.

  5. in Inches / cm Centimeters

    in وcm مطلقة.

    in and cm are absolute.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

إذا كان font-size للعنصر 16px فإن 2em = 32px.

If an element's font-size is 16px, 2em = 32px.

الخلاصة

نسبية (em، %) مقابل مطلقة (px، in، cm).
Relative (em, %) vs absolute (px, in, cm).

الشريحة 16 — CSS Comments

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

NOTE

It is helpful to add comments to your style sheets. Comments take the form:

/* comment goes here */

It is a common practice to locate related style rules together, and then indicate that they are related via a comment. For instance:

/* main navigation */
nav#main { … }
nav#main ul { … }
nav#main ul li { … }
/* header */
header { … }
h1 { … }

Comments can also be a helpful way to temporarily hide any number of rules, to help with debugging.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Comments take the form: /* comment goes here */

    التعليق: /* ... */

    Comment: /* ... */

  2. It is a common practice to locate related style rules together, and then indicate that they are related via a comment…

    اجمع القواعد المرتبطة تحت تعليق.

    Group related rules under a comment.

  3. Comments can also be a helpful way to temporarily hide any number of rules, to help with debugging.

    التعليق يخفي قواعد مؤقتًا لتتبع الأخطاء.

    Comments can hide rules temporarily for debugging.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

CSS لا يدعم تعليقات // (تلك في JavaScript).

CSS has no // comments (those are JavaScript).

الخلاصة

/* تعليق */
/* comment */

الشريحة 17 — Location of Styles

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • CSS style rules can be located in three different locations.
  • Inline Styles
  • Embedded Style Sheet
  • External Style Sheet
  • These three are not mutually exclusive, in that you could place your style rules in all three.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

    ثلاثة أماكن.

  2. These three are not mutually exclusive…

    يمكن استخدامها معًا.

    They can be combined.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

إذا تعارضت، يحسم «الموقع» في التتالي (الشريحة 40).

If they conflict, location in the cascade decides (slide 40).

الخلاصة

inline، embedded، external.
Inline, embedded, external.

الشريحة 18 — Inline Styles

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

Inline styles are style rules placed within an HTML element via the style attribute

An inline style only affects the element it is defined within and overrides any other style definitions for properties used

Notice that a selector is not used here.

<h1>Share Your Travels</h1>
<h2 style="font-size: 24pt">Description</h2>
...
<h2 style="font-size: 24pt; font-weight: bold;">Reviews</h2>

LISTING 4.1 Inline styles example

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Inline styles are style rules placed within an HTML element via the style attribute

    داخل العنصر بخاصية style.

    Inside the element via style.

  2. An inline style only affects the element it is defined within and overrides any other style definitions for properties used

    يؤثر على العنصر فقط ويغلب غيره.

    Affects only that element and overrides others.

  3. Notice that a selector is not used here.

    لا يوجد محدد.

    No selector.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

عيبه: يخلط المظهر بالمعنى ويكرر الكود (لاحظ font-size: 24pt مكررة).

Drawback: it mixes looks with meaning and repeats code (note font-size: 24pt repeated).

الخلاصة

inline: الأقوى والأسوأ للصيانة.
Inline: strongest, worst to maintain.

الشريحة 19 — Embedded Style Sheet

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

Embedded style sheets (also called internal styles) are style rules placed within the <style> element (inside the <head> element of an HTML document)

While better than inline styles, using embedded styles is also generally discouraged.

<head>
   <meta charset="utf-8">
   <title>Chapter 4</title>
   <style>
      h1 { font-size: 24pt; }
      h2 {
         font-size: 18pt;
         font-weight: bold;
      }
   </style>
</head>
<body>

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Embedded style sheets (also called internal styles) are style rules placed within the <style> element (inside the <head> element…)

    داخل <style> في <head>.

    Inside <style> in <head>.

  2. While better than inline styles, using embedded styles is also generally discouraged.

    أفضل من inline لكن غير مستحسن.

    Better than inline, still discouraged.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

العيب: تبقى خاصة بصفحة واحدة؛ صفحات أخرى لا تستفيد منها.

The drawback: they belong to one page; other pages can't reuse them.

embedded: <style> في head.

الشريحة 20 — External Style Sheet

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

External style sheets are style rules placed within an external text file with the .css extension.

When you change an external style sheet, all HTML documents that reference that style sheet will automatically use the updated version.

The browser is able to cache the external style sheet, which can improve performance as well.

<head>
   <meta charset="utf-8">
   <title>Chapter 4</title>
   <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css" />
</head>

LISTING 4.3 Referencing an external style sheet

الشرح — جملة بجملة

    ملف .css منفصل.

    A separate .css file.

  2. When you change an external style sheet, all HTML documents that reference that style sheet will automatically use the updated version.

    تغييره يحدث كل الصفحات.

    Changing it updates every page.

  3. The browser is able to cache the external style sheet, which can improve performance as well.

    المتصفح يخزنه مؤقتًا.

    The browser caches it.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الطريقة الموصى بها. وتربط بالتخزين المؤقت في المحاضرة 1.

The recommended way. It links to caching from lecture 1.

الشريحة 21 — Selectors

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • When defining CSS rules, you will need to use a selector.
  • Selectors tell the browser which elements will be affected by the property values
  • Selectors allow you to select individual or multiple HTML elements.
  • Three basic selector types have been around since the earliest CSS2 specification.
    • Element Selectors
    • Class Selectors
    • Id Selectors

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Selectors tell the browser which elements will be affected by the property values

    المحددات تحدد العناصر.

    Selectors pick elements.

  2. Selectors allow you to select individual or multiple HTML elements.

    عنصر واحد أو أكثر.

    One or many elements.

  3. Three basic selector types … Element Selectors / Class Selectors / Id Selectors

    ثلاثة أساسية: عنصر، class، id.

    Three basics: element, class, id.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الشرائح 23–35 تشرح أنواعًا أكثر: الخصائص، الزائفة، السياقية.

Slides 23–35 add more: attribute, pseudo, contextual.

الخلاصة

element، .class، #id.
element, .class, #id.

الشريحة 22 — The Document Object Model (DOM)

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • NOTE
  • The Document Object Model (DOM) is how a browser represents an HTML page internally. This DOM is akin to a tree representing the overall hierarchical structure of the document.
  • In the last chapter, we learned some of the familial terminologies (such as descendants, ancestors, siblings, etc.) in an HTML document. You will at times have to think about the elements in your HTML document in terms of their position within the hierarchy.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. The Document Object Model (DOM) is how a browser represents an HTML page internally. This DOM is akin to a tree…

    DOM: تمثيل المتصفح الداخلي للصفحة كشجرة.

    The DOM: the browser's internal tree of the page.

  2. …You will at times have to think about the elements in your HTML document in terms of their position within the hierarchy.

    ستحتاج التفكير بمواقع العناصر في الشجرة.

    You'll need to think about elements' positions in the tree.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

هذا أساس المحددات السياقية (الشريحة 33).

This is the basis of contextual selectors (slide 33).

الخلاصة

DOM = شجرة الصفحة.
DOM = the page tree.

الشريحة 23 — Element Selectors

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

Element selectors select all instances of a given HTML element.

You can also select all elements by using the universal element selector (*)

You can select a group of elements by separating the different element names with commas.

/* commas allow you to group selectors */
p, div, aside {
   margin: 0;
   padding: 0;
}
/* the above single grouped selector is equivalent to the
following: */
p {
   margin: 0;
   padding: 0;
}
div {
   margin: 0;
   padding: 0;
}
aside {
   margin: 0;
   padding: 0;
}

LISTING 4.4 Sample grouped selector

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Element selectors select all instances of a given HTML element.

    محدد العنصر يختار كل نسخه.

    An element selector picks every instance.

  2. You can also select all elements by using the universal element selector (*)

    * يختار كل العناصر.

    * selects everything.

  3. You can select a group of elements by separating the different element names with commas.

    الفاصلة تجمع عدة محددات.

    Commas group selectors.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

القاعدة المجمعة p, div, aside تساوي ثلاث قواعد منفصلة (Listing 4.4).

The grouped rule p, div, aside equals three separate rules (Listing 4.4).

الخلاصة

p، *، p, div.
p, *, p, div.

الشريحة 24 — Class and ID Selectors

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • A class selector allows you to simultaneously target different HTML elements regardless of their position in the document tree.
  • HTML elements labeled with the same class attribute value, can be targeted for styling by using a class selector, which takes the form:
  • .class_name
  • An ID selector allows you to target a specific element by its id attribute regardless of its type or position in the document tree.
  • HTML elements labeled with an id attribute, can be targeted for styling by using an id selector, which takes the form:
  • #id_name

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. A class selector allows you to simultaneously target different HTML elements regardless of their position…

    class يستهدف عناصر مختلفة معًا.

    A class targets different elements at once.

  2. …takes the form: .class_name

    .class_name

    .class_name

  3. An ID selector allows you to target a specific element by its id attribute…

    id يستهدف عنصرًا واحدًا محددًا.

    An id targets one specific element.

  4. …takes the form: #id_name

    #id_name

    #id_name

الشرح — شرح موسّع

class قابل للتكرار في الصفحة، id فريد. ولهذا id أكثر تحديدًا (specificity) من class.

A class can repeat on a page; an id is unique. That's why id is more specific than class.

الخلاصة

.class متعدد، #id فريد.
.class many, #id unique.

الشريحة 25 — FIGURE 4.4 An Id and Class Selector Example

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Consider the given figure. The original HTML can be modified to add class and id values, which are then styled in CSS.
  • Id selector #first matches the div with id “first”
  • Class selectors .orange and .circle, match all divs with those class values.
  • Notice that an element can be tagged with multiple classes.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

.general { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
#first { background-color: seagreen; width: 20px; height: 20px; }
.circle { background-color: royalblue; border-radius: 50%; width: 20px; height: 20px; }
.orange{ background-color: orange; width: 20px; height: 20px; }

<div class="general"></div>
<div id="first"></div>
<div class="circle"></div>
<div class="circle"></div>
<div class="orange"></div>
<div class="circle orange"></div>

Result: a green square (#first), two blue circles (.circle), an orange square (.orange), an orange circle (circle orange). The plain version without CSS shows nothing.

  1. Consider the given figure. The original HTML can be modified to add class and id values, which are then styled in CSS.

    نضيف class وid للـ HTML ثم ننسقها.

    #first يطابق div id=first.

    عنصر واحد قد يحمل أكثر من class.

آخر div بـ class="circle orange" يأخذ border-radius من .circle ولونًا من .orange: دائرة برتقالية. والصفحة بلا CSS (fig4-4-plain.html) فارغة لأن div بلا محتوى.

الشريحة 26 — Attribute Selectors

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • An attribute selector provides a way to select HTML elements either by the presence of an element attribute or by the value of an attribute.
  • Attribute selectors can be helpful in the styling of hyperlinks and form elements (which come up in the next chapter)
  • These selectors can be combined with the element id and class selectors.
  • You use square brackets to create attribute selectors (see Table 4.3)

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

    محدد الخاصية: بوجود خاصية أو قيمتها.

    Attribute selector: by an attribute's presence or value.

  2. …helpful in the styling of hyperlinks and form elements…

    مفيد للروابط والنماذج.

    Handy for links and forms.

  3. These selectors can be combined with the element id and class selectors.

    يمكن دمجها مع غيرها.

    Can be combined with others.

  4. You use square brackets to create attribute selectors (see Table 4.3)

    بأقواس مربعة. (الجدول في الشريحة 27 عنوانه Table 4.4.)

    Square brackets. (The table on slide 27 is titled Table 4.4.)

الشرح — شرح موسّع

مثال: a[href$=".pdf"] يضيف أيقونة PDF لروابط PDF فقط.

E.g. a[href$=".pdf"] adds a PDF icon to PDF links only.

الخلاصة

[attr] و[attr=value].

الشريحة 27 — TABLE 4.4 Attribute Selectors

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

TABLE 4.4 Attribute Selectors
SelectorMatchesExample
[ ]A specific attribute.[title] Matches any element with a title attribute
[=]A specific attribute with a specific value.a[title="posts from this country"] Matches any <a> element whose title attribute is exactly “posts from this country”
[~=]A specific attribute whose value matches at least one of the words in a space-delimited list of words.[title~="Countries"] Matches any title attribute that contains the word “Countries“
[^=]A specific attribute whose value begins with a specified value.a[href^="mailto"] Matches any <a> element whose href attribute begins with “mailto“
[*=]A specific attribute whose value contains a substring.img[src*="flag"] Matches any <img> element whose src attribute contains somewhere within it the text “flag“
[$=]A specific attribute whose value ends with a specified value.a[href$=".pdf"] Matches any <a> element whose href attribute ends with the text “.pdf“

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. [ ] [=] [~=] [^=] [*=] [$=]

    ستة أشكال.

    Six forms.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

تذكر الرموز: ^ البداية، $ النهاية، * يحتوي، ~ كلمة في قائمة. (نفس معاني التعابير النمطية.)

Remember: ^ starts, $ ends, * contains, ~ a word in a list. (Same as regular expressions.)

الخلاصة

^= يبدأ، $= ينتهي، *= يحتوي.
^= starts, $= ends, *= contains.

[Title only; the content is the figure.]

input[type="text"] {
   height: 40px;

الشريحة 29 — Pseudo-Element and Pseudo-Class Selectors

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • A pseudo-element selector is a way to select something that does not exist explicitly as an element in the HTML document tree.
  • You can select the first line or first letter of any HTML element using a pseudo-element selector.
  • A pseudo-class selector targets either a particular state or a variety of family relationships
  • This type of selector is for targeting link states and for adding hover styling for other elements

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. A pseudo-element selector is a way to select something that does not exist explicitly as an element in the HTML document tree.

    العنصر الزائف: شيء غير موجود كعنصر صريح.

    Pseudo-element: something not explicitly an element.

  2. You can select the first line or first letter of any HTML element…

    مثل أول سطر أو أول حرف.

    Like the first line or letter.

  3. A pseudo-class selector targets either a particular state or a variety of family relationships

    الفئة الزائفة: حالة أو علاقة عائلية.

    Pseudo-class: a state or family relationship.

  4. This type of selector is for targeting link states and for adding hover styling for other elements

    مثل حالات الروابط وhover.

الشريحة 33 — Contextual Selectors

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • A contextual selector (in CSS3 also called combinators) allows you to select elements based on their ancestors, descendants, or siblings.
  • A descendant selector matches all elements that are contained within another element. The character used to indicate descendant selection is a space “ “
  • A child selector matches a specified element that is a direct child of the specified element. The character used is a “>”
  • An Adjacent selector matches a specified element that is the next sibling of the specified element. The character used is a “+”
  • A General selector matches All following elements that shares the same parent as the specified element. The character used is a “~”

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. A contextual selector (in CSS3 also called combinators) allows you to select elements based on their ancestors, descendants, or siblings.

    المحدد السياقي (combinator): حسب الأسلاف أو الأحفاد أو الأخوة.

    Contextual selector (combinator): by ancestors, descendants or siblings.

  2. A descendant selector … space “ “

    الحفيد: مسافة.

    Descendant: a space.

  3. A child selector … “>”

    الابن المباشر: >.

    Direct child: >.

  4. An Adjacent selector … next sibling … “+”

    الأخ التالي مباشرة: +.

    Next sibling: +.

  5. A General selector … All following elements that shares the same parent … “~”

    كل الأخوة التاليين: ~.

    All following siblings: ~.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الفرق بين المسافة و>: «div p» يطابق أي p داخل div مهما عمق، و«div>p» فقط الأبناء المباشرين.

Space vs >: “div p” matches any p inside a div at any depth; “div>p” only direct children.

الخلاصة

مسافة، >، +، ~.
space, >, +, ~.

الشريحة 36 — The Cascade: How Styles Interact

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • The “Cascade” in CSS refers to how conflicting rules are handled.
  • CSS uses the following cascade principles to help it deal with conflicts:
  • inheritance,
  • specificity, and
  • location.
  • Types of stylesheets:
  • Author-created
  • User-defined
  • Browser style sheet

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. The “Cascade” in CSS refers to how conflicting rules are handled.

    التتالي: كيف تُحل القواعد المتعارضة.

    The cascade: how conflicting rules are resolved.

  2. …inheritance, specificity, and location.

    ثلاثة مبادئ: الوراثة، التحديد، الموقع.

    Three principles: inheritance, specificity, location.

  3. Types of stylesheets: Author-created / User-defined / Browser style sheet

    ثلاثة مصادر للأنماط: المؤلف، المستخدم، المتصفح.

    Three style sources: author, user, browser.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الشرائح 37–40 تشرح المبادئ الثلاثة بالترتيب.

Slides 37–40 cover the three principles in order.

الخلاصة

وراثة، تحديد، موقع.
Inheritance, specificity, location.

الشريحة 37 — The Cascade: Inheritance

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Inheritance is the principle that many CSS properties affect their descendants as well as themselves.
  • Font, color, list, and text properties (from Table 4.1) are inheritable;
  • Layout, sizing, border, background, and spacing properties are not.
  • it is also possible to inherit properties that are normally not inheritable using inherit

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

body {
   font-family: Arial;     /* Inherited */
   color: red;             /* Inherited */
   border: 8pt solid green;/* Not inherited */
   margin: 60px;           /* Not inherited */
}

p {
   border: inherit;
   margin: inherit;
}

Tree: html → head (meta, title), body → h1, h2, ul (li, li), h3, p, p (a), div (p, p → time), div (p, p → time), p (small). Screenshot: “Share Your Travels / New York - Central Park” in red with a green border.

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Inheritance is the principle that many CSS properties affect their descendants as well as themselves.

    الوراثة: خصائص كثيرة تنتقل للأحفاد.

    Inheritance: many properties pass to descendants.

  2. Font, color, list, and text properties … are inheritable;

    الخط واللون والقوائم والنص تُورث.

    Font, colour, list and text are inherited.

  3. Layout, sizing, border, background, and spacing properties are not.

    التخطيط والأحجام والحدود والخلفية والمسافات لا تُورث.

    Layout, sizing, border, background and spacing aren't.

  4. …possible to inherit properties that are normally not inheritable using inherit

    القيمة inherit تفرض الوراثة.

    The value inherit forces inheritance.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

في الشكل: font-family وcolor على body ترثها كل العناصر، أما border وmargin فلا (لذلك الحد الأخضر حول body فقط).

In the figure: font-family and color on body are inherited by everything, but border and margin aren't (hence the green border only around body).

الخلاصة

النص يُورث، الصندوق لا.
Text is inherited, the box isn't.

الشريحة 38 — The Cascade: Specificity

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Specificity is how the browser determines which style rule takes precedence when more than one style rule could be applied.
  • The more specific selector takes precedence
  • Class selectors take precedence over element selectors, and id selectors take precedence over class selectors
  • Note: In figure 4.14 <body> color and font-weight properties are overridden by the more specific <div> and <p> selectors.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

body { font-weight: bold; color: red; }
div { font-weight: normal; color: magenta; }
p { color: green; }
.last { color: blue; }
#verylast { color: orange; font-size: 16pt; }

<body>
  This text is not within a p element.
  <p>Reviews</p>
  <div>
    <p>By Ricardo on <time>2016-05-23</time></p>
    <p>Easy on the HDR buddy.</p>
    This text is not within a p element.
  </div>
  <hr/>
  <div>
    <p>By Susan on <time>2016-11-18</time></p>
    <p>I love Central Park.</p>
  </div>
  <hr/>
  <div>
    <p class="last">By Dave on <time>2016-11-24</time></p>
    <p class="last" id="verylast">Thanks for posting.</p>
  </div>
  <hr/>
</body>

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Specificity is how the browser determines which style rule takes precedence when more than one style rule could be applied.

    التحديد: أي قاعدة تفوز عند التعارض.

    Specificity: which rule wins a conflict.

  2. The more specific selector takes precedence

    الأكثر تحديدًا يفوز.

    The more specific wins.

  3. Class selectors take precedence over element selectors, and id selectors take precedence over class selectors

    class > element، وid > class.

    class > element, id > class.

  4. Note: In figure 4.14 <body> color and font-weight properties are overridden by the more specific <div> and <p> selectors.

    خصائص body غُلبت بمحددات div وp الأكثر تحديدًا.

    body's properties are overridden by the more specific div and p.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

في الشكل: النص خارج p يأخذ أحمر body أو ماجنتا div، والفقرات خضراء (p)، و.last زرقاء، و#verylast برتقالية لأن id الأقوى.

In the figure: text outside p takes body's red or div's magenta, paragraphs are green (p), .last is blue, and #verylast is orange because id is strongest.

الخلاصة

id > class > element.
id > class > element.

الشريحة 39 — Simplified Specificity algorithm

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

[Title only; the content is the figure.]

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

Simplified specificity algorithm (transcribed)
RankSelector typeExampleSpecificity value
1inline style attribute<div style="color: red;">1000
2id + additional selectorsdiv #firstExample { color: grey; }0101
3id selector#firstExample { color: magenta; }0100
4class and attribute selectors.example { color: blue; }   a[href$=".pdf"] { color: blue; }0010
5descendant selector (elements only)div form { color: orange; }0002
6element selectordiv { color: green; }0001

Note in figure: A higher specificity value overrides lower specificity values. Each step “overrides” the one below it.

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. (figure) inline style 1000 > id + additional 0101 > id 0100 > class/attribute 0010 > descendant 0002 > element 0001

    قيم التحديد مرتبة.

    Specificity values in order.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

كيف تحسب (إضافي بصيغة الكتاب): أربع خانات (inline، id، class/attribute، element). مثال: div #firstExample = 0 inline، 1 id، 0 class، 1 element = 0101.

How to compute (additional, book format): four digits (inline, id, class/attribute, element). E.g. div #firstExample = 0 inline, 1 id, 0 class, 1 element = 0101.

مثال رقمي محلول

#main div p:first-child  -> id=1, class/pseudo-class=1, elements=2 -> 0112
ul a:link                -> class/pseudo-class=1, elements=2       -> 0012
.last                    -> 0010
p                        -> 0001
#main div p:first-child  -> id=1, class/pseudo-class=1, elements=2 -> 0112
ul a:link                -> class/pseudo-class=1, elements=2       -> 0012
.last                    -> 0010
p                        -> 0001

(Pseudo-classes count like classes.)

الخلاصة

inline 1000، id 0100، class 0010، element 0001.
inline 1000, id 0100, class 0010, element 0001.

الشريحة 40 — The Cascade: Location

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Finally, when inheritance and specificity cannot determine style precedence, the principle of location will be used.
  • When rules have the same specificity, then the latest are given more weight.
  • For instance, an inline style will override one defined in an external author style sheet or an embedded style sheet.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

Browser's default style settings
   <- overrides (1) user-styles.css
   <- overrides (2) <link rel="stylesheet" href="stylesA.css" />   (#example { color: green; })
   <- overrides (3) <link rel="stylesheet" href="stylesWW.css" />  (#example { color: blue; })
   <- overrides (4) <style> #example { color: orange; color: magenta; } </style>
        (5) inside the rule, color: magenta overrides color: orange
   <- overrides (6) <p id="example" style="color: red;">sample text</p>

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. …when inheritance and specificity cannot determine style precedence, the principle of location will be used.

    إذا لم تحسم الوراثة والتحديد، يحسم الموقع.

    If inheritance and specificity don't decide, location does.

  2. When rules have the same specificity, then the latest are given more weight.

    عند التساوي: الأحدث (الأخير) يفوز.

    On a tie, the latest wins.

  3. …an inline style will override one defined in an external author style sheet or an embedded style sheet.

    inline يغلب external وembedded.

    Inline beats external and embedded.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الترتيب في الشكل من الأضعف للأقوى: إعدادات المتصفح ← أنماط المستخدم ← stylesA.css ← stylesWW.css ← <style> ← inline. وحتى داخل نفس القاعدة: color: magenta بعد orange يغلبه.

Order in the figure, weakest to strongest: browser defaults → user styles → stylesA.css → stylesWW.css → <style> → inline. Even within one rule, color: magenta after orange wins.

الخلاصة

الأخير يفوز عند تساوي التحديد.
The last one wins when specificity ties.

الشريحة 41 — The Box Model

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • In CSS, all HTML elements exist within an element box. In order to become proficient with CSS, you must become familiar with the box model.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

Labels (outside in): margin · border · padding · width / height · element content area · background-color/background-image of element (fills padding and content) · background-color/background-image of element's parent (shows in the margin)

🖼 إظهار وصف الإتاحة

مخطط معاد بناؤه

+----------------- margin (parent's background) -----------------+
|  +-------------------- border --------------------+          |
|  |  padding (element's background)                 |          |
|  |    +----- content: width x height -----+       |          |
|  |    +------------------------------------+       |          |
|  +--------------------------------------------------+          |
+----------------------------------------------------------------+

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. In CSS, all HTML elements exist within an element box. In order to become proficient with CSS, you must become familiar with the box model.

    كل عنصر داخل «صندوق»؛ فهمه أساسي.

    Every element sits in a box; understanding it is essential.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

من الداخل للخارج: المحتوى (width × height) ← padding ← border ← margin. وخلفية العنصر تملأ حتى الحد، أما الهامش فيُظهر خلفية الأب.

Inside out: content (width × height) → padding → border → margin. The element's background fills up to the border; the margin shows the parent's background.

الخلاصة

content ← padding ← border ← margin.
content → padding → border → margin.

الشريحة 42 — Block Elements

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Block-level elements such as <p>, <div>, <h2>, <ul>, and <table> are each contained on their own line.
  • without styling, two block-level elements can’t exist on the same line
  • Block-level elements use the normal CSS box model
  • It is possible to change whether an element is block-level or inline using display property:
  • span {display: block;}

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

    العناصر الكتلية كل منها في سطر.

    Block elements each take their own line.

  2. without styling, two block-level elements can’t exist on the same line

    لا يجتمع كتليان في سطر بلا تنسيق.

    Two blocks can't share a line unstyled.

  3. Block-level elements use the normal CSS box model

    تستخدم نموذج الصندوق العادي.

    They use the normal box model.

  4. …change whether an element is block-level or inline using display property: span {display: block;}

    display يغير النوع.

    display changes the type.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

block = سطر كامل.

الشريحة 43 — Inline Elements

الشريحة 49 — Margins and Padding

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Margins add spacing around an element’s content
  • Padding adds spacing within elements.
  • Borders divide the margin area from the padding area.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

   border: solid 1pt red;
   margin: 30px;
   padding: 0;
}

   border: solid 1pt red;
   margin: 0;
   padding: 30px;
}

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Margins add spacing around an element’s content

    الهامش: مسافة حول العنصر.

    Margin: space around the element.

  2. Padding adds spacing within elements.

    الحشو: مسافة داخل العنصر.

    Padding: space inside the element.

  3. Borders divide the margin area from the padding area.

    الحد يفصل الهامش عن الحشو.

    The border separates margin from padding.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

في الشكل: margin: 30px يبعد الفقرات عن بعضها (30px بينها، لاحظ انطباق الهوامش في الشريحة 50)، وpadding: 30px يبعد النص عن الحد الأحمر من الداخل.

In the figure: margin: 30px spaces the paragraphs apart (30px between them; note margin collapsing on slide 50), and padding: 30px pushes the text away from the red border inside.

الخلاصة

margin خارج الحد، padding داخله.
Margin outside the border, padding inside.

الشريحة 50 — Collapsing margins

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • The W3C defines collapsing margins as:
  • In CSS, the adjoining margins of two or more boxes (which might or might not be siblings) can combine to form a single margin. Margins that combine this way are said to collapse, and the resulting combined margin is called a collapsed margin.
  • What this means is that when the vertical margins of two elements touch, only the largest margin value of the elements will be displayed
  • Horizontal margins, on the other hand, never collapse.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. In CSS, the adjoining margins of two or more boxes … can combine to form a single margin … called a collapsed margin.

    الهوامش المتجاورة قد تندمج في هامش واحد.

    Adjoining margins can merge into one.

  2. …when the vertical margins of two elements touch, only the largest margin value of the elements will be displayed

    رأسيًا: يظهر الأكبر فقط.

    Vertically: only the larger shows.

  3. Horizontal margins, on the other hand, never collapse.

    الأفقية لا تنطبق.

    Horizontal margins never collapse.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

لهذا في الشريحة 49 المسافة بين الفقرتين 30px لا 60px.

That's why on slide 49 the gap between paragraphs is 30px, not 60px.

مثال رقمي محلول

فقرة margin-bottom: 20px تليها فقرة margin-top: 50px ← المسافة = max(20, 50) = 50px (لا 70px). ولو كانتا متجاورتين أفقيًا (inline-block) = 20 + 50 = 70px.

A paragraph with margin-bottom: 20px followed by one with margin-top: 50px → gap = max(20, 50) = 50px (not 70px). Side by side horizontally (inline-block) it'd be 20 + 50 = 70px.

الخلاصة

رأسيًا max(a, b)، أفقيًا a + b.
Vertical: max(a, b); horizontal: a + b.

الشريحة 51 — Box Model: All or one

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

NOTE

With border, margin, and padding properties, it is possible to set the properties for one or more sides in a single property, or individually

border-top-color: red; /* sets just the top side */
border-right-color: green; /* sets just the right side */
border-bottom-color: yellow; /* sets just the bottom side */
border-left-color: blue; /* sets just the left side */

Alternately, we can set all four sides to a single value via:

border-color: red; /* sets all four sides to red */

Or we can set all four sides to different values via:

border-color: red green orange blue;

Another shortcut is to use just two values; in this case the first value sets top and bottom, while the second sets the right and left.

border-color: red yellow; /* top+bottom=red, right+left=yellow */

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. …it is possible to set the properties for one or more sides in a single property, or individually

    لجانب واحد أو كل الجوانب.

    Per side or all sides.

  2. border-color: red; /* sets all four sides to red */

    قيمة واحدة = كل الجوانب.

    One value = all sides.

  3. border-color: red green orange blue;

    أربع قيم: أعلى، يمين، أسفل، يسار.

    Four values: top, right, bottom, left.

  4. border-color: red yellow; /* top+bottom=red, right+left=yellow */

    قيمتان: (أعلى+أسفل)، (يمين+يسار).

    Two values: (top+bottom), (right+left).

الشرح — شرح موسّع

تذكر الترتيب كعقارب الساعة بدءًا من الأعلى: TRouBLe (Top, Right, Bottom, Left).

Remember the clockwise order from the top: TRouBLe (Top, Right, Bottom, Left).

الخلاصة

1، 2، أو 4 قيم.
1, 2 or 4 values.

الشريحة 52 — Box Dimensions

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Block-level elements have width and height properties.
  • They also have a min-width, min-height, max-width, and max-height properties as well to help when the width or a height might be specified as a % of its parent container
  • Since the width and the height only refer to the size of the content area, the total size of an element is equal to the size of its content area plus the sum of its padding, borders, and margins.
  • To reduce complexity of adding margins, content and borders, you can use the newer border-box approach.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الصيغ

total width = width + 2*padding + 2*border + 2*margin

قراءة قارئ الشاشة: العرض الكلي يساوي العرض زائد ضعف الحشو زائد ضعف الحد زائد ضعف الهامش.Total width equals width plus twice the padding plus twice the border plus twice the margin.

في نموذج content-box الافتراضي (صيغة توضيحية).

In the default content-box model (illustrative formula).

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Block-level elements have width and height properties.

    للكتلية width وheight.

    Blocks have width and height.

  2. …min-width, min-height, max-width, and max-height…

    وحدود دنيا وعليا.

    And min/max limits.

  3. …the total size of an element is equal to the size of its content area plus the sum of its padding, borders, and margins.

    الحجم الكلي = المحتوى + الحشو + الحدود + الهوامش.

    Total = content + padding + borders + margins.

  4. …you can use the newer border-box approach.

    الحل الأسهل: border-box.

    Easier: border-box.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الشريحة 53 تقارن الطريقتين بالأرقام.

Slide 53 compares both approaches with numbers.

الخلاصة

width = المحتوى فقط (افتراضيًا).
width = content only (by default).

الشريحة 53 — The border-box approach

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • box-sizing: border-box (EASY!)
  • Figure credits to:https://stackoverflow.com/questions/44453391/what-is-the-difference-between-border-box-and-content-box-in-css

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

/* left: Box Model is content-box */      /* right: Box Model is border-box */
div{                                       div{
   width: 300px;                              width: 300px;
   height: 200px;                             height: 200px;
   padding: 15px;                             padding: 15px;
   border: 5px solid grey;                    border: 5px solid grey;
   margin: 30px;                              margin: 30px;
   -moz-box-sizing: content-box;              -moz-box-sizing: border-box;
   -webkit-box-sizing: content-box;           -webkit-box-sizing: border-box;
   box-sizing: content-box;                   box-sizing: border-box;
}                                          }
/* content area: 300 x 200 */              /* content area: 260 x 160 */

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. box-sizing: border-box (EASY!)

    border-box: width يشمل الحشو والحد.

    border-box: width includes padding and border.

  2. Figure credits to: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/44453391/…

    مصدر الشكل.

    Figure credit.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

نفس الأرقام في الحالتين (width 300، padding 15، border 5، margin 30): في content-box المحتوى 300×200 والصندوق المرئي أكبر؛ في border-box الصندوق المرئي 300×200 والمحتوى يصغر إلى 260×160.

Same numbers in both (width 300, padding 15, border 5, margin 30): with content-box the content is 300×200 and the visible box is bigger; with border-box the visible box is 300×200 and the content shrinks to 260×160.

مثال رقمي محلول

content-box: visible width = 300 + 2*15 + 2*5 = 340 ; with margins = 340 + 60 = 400
border-box : visible width = 300 ; content = 300 - 2*15 - 2*5 = 260
             visible height = 200 ; content = 200 - 30 - 10 = 160
content-box: visible width = 300 + 2*15 + 2*5 = 340 ; with margins = 340 + 60 = 400
border-box : visible width = 300 ; content = 300 - 2*15 - 2*5 = 260
             visible height = 200 ; content = 200 - 30 - 10 = 160

الخلاصة

border-box يجعل width = العرض المرئي.
border-box makes width = the visible width.

الشريحة 55 — Box sizing via percent

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Using percentages, makes the size relative to the size of the parent element, while using ems makes the size of the box relative to the size of the text within it.
  • Using these relative measures is to make the design scalable to the size of the browser or device that is viewing it.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

html,body {
   margin:0;
   width:100%;

   background: silver;

   width:200px;
   height:50px;
   background: teal;
}
.percent {
   width:50%;
   height:50%;
   background: olive;
}
<body>
   <div class="pixels">
      Pixels - 200px by 50 px
   </div>
   <div class="percent">
      Percent - 50% of width and height
   </div>
</body>

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Using percentages, makes the size relative to the size of the parent element, while using ems makes the size of the box relative to the size of the text within it.

    % نسبة من الأب، em نسبة من حجم النص.

    % is relative to the parent, em to the text size.

  2. Using these relative measures is to make the design scalable to the size of the browser or device…

    الوحدات النسبية تجعل التصميم يتكيف.

    Relative units make designs scale.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

في الشكل: صندوق .pixels يبقى 200×50 مهما تغير حجم النافذة، أما .percent فيبقى نصف عرض وارتفاع النافذة.

In the figure: the .pixels box stays 200×50 whatever the window size, while .percent stays half the window's width and height.

الخلاصة

% يتغير مع الأب، px ثابت.
% changes with the parent; px is fixed.

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • CSS provides two types of properties that affect text.
  • Font properties that affect the font and its appearance.
  • Paragraph properties that affect the text in a similar way no matter which font is being used
  • Many of the most common font properties are shown in Table 4.9 and include
    • Font, font-family, font-style, font-size, font-variant, font-weight

  2. Font properties that affect the font and its appearance.

    خصائص الخط.

    Font properties.

  3. Paragraph properties that affect the text in a similar way no matter which font is being used

    خصائص الفقرة (مستقلة عن الخط).

    Paragraph properties (font-independent).

  4. Font, font-family, font-style, font-size, font-variant, font-weight

    خصائص الخط الشائعة.

    Common font properties.

الخلاصة

خط مقابل فقرة.
Font vs paragraph.

الشريحة 57 — Font Family

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Just because a given font is available on the web developer’s computer does not mean it will be available for all users.
  • For this reason, it is conventional to supply a so-called web font stack— a series of alternate fonts to use in case the original font choice is not on the user’s computer

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

p {  font-family: Cambria, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;  }
  1. Use this font as the first choice.
  2. But if it is not available, then use this one.
  3. If it isn't available, then use this one.
  4. And if it is not available either, then use the default generic serif font.

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Just because a given font is available on the web developer’s computer does not mean it will be available for all users.

    الخط عندك قد لا يكون عند المستخدم.

    Your font may not be on the user's machine.

  2. …supply a so-called web font stack— a series of alternate fonts…

    web font stack: قائمة بدائل.

    A web font stack: a list of fallbacks.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

المتصفح يجرب بالترتيب: Cambria ← Georgia ← Times New Roman ← أي خط serif. وآخر عنصر يجب أن يكون اسمًا عامًا (generic).

The browser tries in order: Cambria → Georgia → Times New Roman → any serif. The last item should be a generic family.

الخلاصة

آخر خيار: عائلة عامة.
Last option: a generic family.

الشريحة 58 — Different font families

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

[Title only; the content is the figure.]

Generic Font-Family Name: serif · sans-serif · monospace · cursive · fantasy (each shown with the word “This”).

Notes: “serif” (pointing to the small stroke on “Th”) · “Without ("sans") serif” · “In a monospace font, each letter has the same width.” · “In a regular, proportionally-spaced font, each letter has a variable width.” · “Decorative and cursive fonts vary from system to system; rarely used as a result.”

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. (figure) serif, sans-serif, monospace, cursive, fantasy

    خمس عائلات عامة.

    Five generic families.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

serif لها «زوائد» في أطراف الحروف، sans-serif بلا زوائد، monospace كل الحروف بنفس العرض (مناسب للكود)، cursive وfantasy زخرفية وتختلف بين الأنظمة فنادرًا ما تُستخدم.

Serif has little strokes at letter ends, sans-serif doesn't, monospace gives every letter the same width (good for code), cursive and fantasy are decorative and vary by system, so they're rarely used.

الخلاصة

5 عائلات عامة.
5 generic families.

الشريحة 59 — Font Sizes

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • If we wish to create web layouts that work well on different devices, we should learn to use relative units such as em units or percentages for our font sizes
  • it can quickly become difficult to calculate actual sizes when there are nested elements
    • For this reason, CSS3 now supports a new relative measure, the rem (for root em unit). This unit is always relative to the size of the root element (i.e., the <html> element).
  • To muddy the picture even more, some developers have begun to advocate again for using the pixel as the unit of measure in CSS since modern browsers provide built-in scaling/zooming that preserve layout…

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. …we should learn to use relative units such as em units or percentages for our font sizes

    استخدم وحدات نسبية للخطوط.

    Use relative units for font sizes.

  2. …difficult to calculate actual sizes when there are nested elements … the rem (for root em unit). This unit is always relative to the size of the root element (i.e., the <html> element).

    مع التداخل يصعب الحساب بـ em، لذلك rem: نسبة لحجم <html> دائمًا.

    Nesting makes em hard to compute, hence rem: always relative to <html>.

  3. …some developers have begun to advocate again for using the pixel…

    بعض المطورين عادوا لـ px لأن المتصفحات تدعم التكبير.

    Some developers advocate px again since browsers zoom well.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

مثال: html بحجم 16px، وقائمة متداخلة بـ font-size: 1.2em ← المستوى الثالث = 16 × 1.2³ ≈ 27.6px (يتراكم)، أما 1.2rem فدائمًا 19.2px.

Example: html at 16px and a nested list with font-size: 1.2em → the third level = 16 × 1.2³ ≈ 27.6px (it compounds), while 1.2rem is always 19.2px.

مثال رقمي محلول

html: 16px
level 1: 1.2em = 16 * 1.2   = 19.2px
level 2: 1.2em = 19.2 * 1.2 = 23.04px
level 3: 1.2em = 23.04 * 1.2 = 27.65px
1.2rem at any level          = 19.2px
html: 16px
level 1: 1.2em = 16 * 1.2   = 19.2px
level 2: 1.2em = 19.2 * 1.2 = 23.04px
level 3: 1.2em = 23.04 * 1.2 = 27.65px
1.2rem at any level          = 19.2px

الخلاصة

em يتراكم، rem ثابت بالنسبة للجذر.
em compounds; rem stays relative to the root.

الشريحة 60 — @font-face

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

DIVE DEEPER

The @font-face selector that allows you to use a font even if it is not installed on the user’s computer. Open source font sites such as Google Web Fonts (https://fonts.google.com) and Font Squirrel (http://www.fontsquirrel.com/) have promoted the use of @font-face

To use Droid Sans, you can add the following to your <head> section

<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Droid+Sans" rel="stylesheet" type="text/css">

Or, add the following import inside one of your CSS files:

@import url(https://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Droid+Sans);

Or check out the longer-form @font-face selector (on p 170)

  • Within your CSS you specify which of these weights by using their numeric value, which typically ranges from 100 and 900, with larger numbers bolder than lower numbers

الشريحة 65 — What is a CSS Framework?

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • A CSS framework is a set of CSS classes or other software tools that make it easier to use and work with CSS.
  • Early CSS frameworks like Blueprint and 960 became popular chiefly as a way to more easily create complex grid-based layouts
  • More sophisticated subsequent CSS Frameworks such as
    • Bootstrap (https://getbootstrap.com/)
    • Foundation (https://get.foundation/) provide much more than a grid system; they provide a comprehensive set of predefined CSS classes, which makes it easier to construct a consistent and attractive web interface.
  • Table 4.11 lists even more popular CSS Frameworks
  • https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/v5.3.5/dist/css/bootstrap.css

الشريحة 68 — CSS Variables

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • CSS Variables (also called custom properties) are a new feature that let you
  • Value stored once and use multiple times
  • define variables (which must begin with a double hyphen) at the top of your CSS file usually within a special :root pseudo-class selector, and
  • reference those variables as property values using the var() CSS function.
  • Duplication of colors, spacing, and borders, often happens numerous times within a single file (and rightly so). CSS variables address this issue without using a preprocessor (Chapter 7).
  • https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5wLrz_zUwoU

    تبدأ بـ -- وتُعرف عادة في :root.

    They start with -- and are usually defined in :root.

    تحل التكرار دون معالج مسبق (Sass، الفصل 7).

  --bg-color-main: #431c5d;

  color: var(--bg-color-secondary);

  border-color: var(--fg-color-main);
  padding: var(--padding-boxes);
  color: var(--fg-color-main);
  font-size: var(--fontsize-default);
  margin-top: calc( --fontsize-default / 2 );
}
#results {
  background-color: var(--bg-color-main);
  font-size: var(--fontsize-default:);
  border-radius: var(--radius-boxes);
  padding: var(--padding-boxes);

05 ثلاثة مستويات

  • HTML هيكل البيت، وCSS الدهان والأثاث.
  • المحدد = «لمن»، الخاصية = «ماذا»، القيمة = «كيف».
  • class مثل زي مدرسي يلبسه كثيرون، id مثل رقم الهوية لشخص واحد.
  • التتالي محكمة: الأكثر تحديدًا يفوز، وعند التعادل آخر من تكلم.
  • نموذج الصندوق: هدية (المحتوى) في غلاف (الحشو) داخل علبة (الحد) مع مسافة بين العلب (الهامش).
  • HTML is the house's frame; CSS is the paint and furniture.
  • Selector = “who”, property = “what”, value = “how”.
  • A class is a school uniform many wear; an id is one person's ID number.
  • The cascade is a court: the most specific wins, and on a tie the last speaker.
  • The box model: a gift (content) in wrapping (padding) inside a box (border) with space between boxes (margin).
  • قاعدة CSS: selector { property: value; }؛ القيم: keywords، lengths (px، em، rem، %)، colours (name/rgb/hex/rgba/hsl)، url().
  • المحددات: type، .class، #id، *، grouping (,)، attribute ([a]، =، ~=، ^=، *=، $=)، pseudo-class (:link، :visited، :hover، :active، :focus، :checked، :first-child، :last-child، :nth-child())، pseudo-element (:first-letter، :first-line)، combinators (descendant ' '، child >، adjacent +، general ~).
  • التتالي: inheritance (text/font/colour/list) ← specificity (inline 1000، id 0100، class/attribute/pseudo-class 0010، element 0001) ← location (آخر تعريف عند التساوي؛ browser < user < author).
  • Box model: total = width + padding + border + margin (content-box)؛ border-box يدخل padding وborder في width؛ الهوامش الرأسية تنطبق (max).
  • النص: font stack، generic families، em يتراكم وrem نسبة للجذر، font-weight 100–900، @font-face.
  • A CSS rule: selector { property: value; }; values: keywords, lengths (px, em, rem, %), colours (name/rgb/hex/rgba/hsl), url().
  • Selectors: type, .class, #id, *, grouping (,), attribute ([a], =, ~=, ^=, *=, $=), pseudo-class (:link, :visited, :hover, :active, :focus, :checked, :first-child, :last-child, :nth-child()), pseudo-element (:first-letter, :first-line), combinators (descendant ' ', child >, adjacent +, general ~).
  • Cascade: inheritance (text/font/colour/list) → specificity (inline 1000, id 0100, class/attribute/pseudo-class 0010, element 0001) → location (last definition on a tie; browser < user < author).
  • Box model: total = width + padding + border + margin (content-box); border-box folds padding and border into width; vertical margins collapse (max).
  • Text: font stacks, generic families, em compounds while rem is root-relative, font-weight 100–900, @font-face.
  • selector { property: value; }
  • red = rgb(255,0,0) = #FF0000.
  • external > embedded > inline (للصيانة).
  • .class، #id، *، [attr]، :hover، ::first-letter.
  • ' ' حفيد، > ابن، + تالٍ، ~ تالون.
  • وراثة ← تحديد ← موقع.
  • 1000/0100/0010/0001.
  • content ← padding ← border ← margin.
  • border-box: width = المرئي.
  • هوامش رأسية تنطبق.
  • TRouBLe.
  • overflow: visible/hidden/scroll/auto.
  • rem للجذر، em يتراكم.
  • font-weight 400/700.
  • --var و var().
  • selector { property: value; }
  • red = rgb(255,0,0) = #FF0000.
  • external > embedded > inline (for maintenance).
  • .class, #id, *, [attr], :hover, ::first-letter.
  • ' ' descendant, > child, + adjacent, ~ general.
  • Inheritance → specificity → location.
  • 1000/0100/0010/0001.
  • content → padding → border → margin.
  • border-box: width = visible.
  • Vertical margins collapse.
  • TRouBLe.
  • overflow: visible/hidden/scroll/auto.
  • rem root-relative, em compounds.
  • font-weight 400/700.
  • --var and var().

06 اختبار تفاعلي

النتيجة 0/30

    07 نصائح احترافية

    كيف تفهم بدل أن تحفظ

    • افتح أدوات المطور (F12 ← Elements ← Styles) وشاهد القواعد المشطوبة: هذا التتالي أمامك.
    • احسب التحديد لكل محدد قبل أن تتوقع النتيجة.
    • شاهد لوحة Box Model في أدوات المطور لترى الهامش والحشو بالأرقام.
    • جرب border-box على * وقارن.
    • Open dev tools (F12 → Elements → Styles) and look at the struck-through rules: that's the cascade in front of you.
    • Compute each selector's specificity before predicting the result.
    • Use the Box Model panel in dev tools to see margin and padding in numbers.
    • Try border-box on * and compare.

    تمارين عملية مقترحة

    1. أعد بناء الشكل 4.4 (المربعات والدوائر).
    2. اكتب قوائم الشريحة 32 بكل المحددات الزائفة.
    3. أعد مثال الشريحة 35 وتحقق من الألوان.
    4. حوّل ورقة أنماط إلى متغيرات CSS.
    1. Rebuild Figure 4.4 (squares and circles).
    2. Write slide 32's menus with all the pseudo selectors.
    3. Rebuild slide 35's example and check the colours.
    4. Convert a stylesheet to CSS variables.

    أخطاء شائعة

    • الخلط بين . و#.
    • نسيان ; بين التصريحات.
    • توقع أن border يُورث.
    • جمع الهوامش الرأسية بدل أخذ الأكبر.
    • نسيان أن width في content-box لا يشمل الحشو والحد.
    • استخدام em في عناصر متداخلة وتفاجؤك بالتراكم.
    • كتابة --var بدون var().
    • Mixing up . and #.
    • Forgetting ; between declarations.
    • Expecting border to inherit.
    • Adding vertical margins instead of taking the larger.
    • Forgetting content-box width excludes padding and border.
    • Using em in nested elements and being surprised by compounding.
    • Writing --var without var().
